findings: THE NOTE WAS WRONG AND THE VERDICT WAS NOT. C-0023's 40 pN/nm is 1.2 x (100 pN / 3 nm) and carries the ACCEPTABLE clause's stroke inside it; the same construction at §3's desired clause is 12.0 pN/nm, 3.33x STRICTER. Every one of the 26 rows of T-79's catalogue that places is past both, so the re-wording moves 0 verdicts.

THE MISS DOES NOT REST ON A DECLARED NUMBER AT ALL. 26 of 26 placing rows are also past C-0006's per-path secant ceiling n x allowable / s = 45.0 pN/nm, which is CITED rather than declared and, unlike the tolerance, TIGHTENS as the stroke grows. The softest placing row is 58.0 pN/nm on the secant, 1.29x past it.

THE DEFECT WAS IN A FILE NEITHER RECORD NAMES. C-0101 §4 and the T-169 row both point at synthesis/DesiredStrokeReachStudy.kt and T-108; the string was in anchoring/TwoSpringElasticaStudy.kt and T-79. T-108 is where C-0049 was DERIVED and is the one place in the tree that already read the ceiling with its stroke — so the correction went to the study that inherited the number, not to the one that fixed it.
